finding.root_cause: Both explicit and Monte Carlo PA probability consumers trusted any pitcher profile, BvP factor, platoon value, or opposing-pitcher identity present in a feature bundle. FeatureFactory populated that bundle from the current schedule/legacy pitching-stat path without a T-minus-4 receipt or strict point-in-time profile lineage.
finding.repair: A shared consumer gate now requires a hash-bound T-minus-4 probable-starter authorization and separately hash-bound strictly pregame pitcher profile. Missing evidence neutralizes the entire pitcher/BvP/platoon block; contradictory evidence terminates. The feature factory does not call the legacy pitcher-stat or matchup-intelligence path in strict mode. Explicit and simulated probabilities call the same resolver.
finding.production_baseline: The default legacy_frozen mode preserves the frozen comparator. New candidates must explicitly select receipt_required_or_exclude.
finding.historical_reconstruction: None. No permissible historical artifact can manufacture a prospective starter receipt; missing receipts remain permanently missing.
finding.promotion: No model promotion and no betting authorization.
